## Source: amazon-inspector (913b23ea87926b9e184f9e02b7d817486565fdc4c81fd0bc7cadda2fb7e2ff5a)
Analysis of voxilaratts 0.1.0 on PyPI produced no indicators of installer-targeting behavior. No install-time or import-time network activity, credential or filesystem reads of sensitive paths, subprocess execution of fetched content, lifecycle hooks performing privileged actions, or hardcoded exfiltration endpoints were observed in the package contents.

## Source: kam193 (39377b8b4c1d6d3243cb82f3e86bdc38869bf56e3800bf02ae817a1555ddb11b)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
